diagnosis: The Ray telemetry route filters Ray cluster actor state by deployment_name without checking if the caller belongs to the tenant that owns the deployment. Unauthorized users can map internal node IP addresses, process IDs, and deployment status across all tenants in the shared cluster.
exploit_request:
GET /telemetry/ray/deployments/secops_guardrail_service/metrics HTTP/1.1
Host: ray-metrics.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
